brief_summary: To compare the effects of different initial insulin dose regimens during the short-term insulin intensive treatment on time to glycemic goal, hypoglycemia prevalence, glycemic variability and other safety problems in newly diagnosed type 2 diabetes mellitus(T2DM) patients, in order to investigate the rational of formula based initiation regimen.
brief_title: Different Initial Insulin Dose Regimens on Time to Achieve Glycemic Targets and Treatment Safety in SIIT
